author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಚಿಂತೆಚಿತೆಗಳಲಿಹುದು ಒಂದು ವರ್ಣದ ಭೇದ
ಜೊತೆಯಲ್ಲೆ ಹುಟ್ಟಿ ಕೊನೆ ಕ್ಷಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಂತ್ಯ
ಸಂತೆ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂತೆ ಕೊರಗನು ಹೊತ್ತು
ಅಂತಿಮದ ಗುರಿ ಸಾವು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Between worry and the funeral pyre there is the difference of one letter;
born together, they end together at the final moment;
in the marketplace of life, carrying a bundle of sorrows,
our last goal is death, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: In Kannada, chinte (worry) and chite (pyre) differ by a single letter. Worry is born with us and stays until the end. Why carry a bundle of sorrow through life’s bazaar when death is where it all ends?
